headline: New development in the fund investigation: Chief Public Prosecutor's Office requests investigation permission
summary: Istanbul Chief Public Prosecutor's Office requested permission to investigate SPK Chairman İbrahim Ömer Gönül for abuse of office. It cited clear and sufficient signs of failing to supervise duties.
why: The SPK is Turkey's capital markets regulator, so investigations of its leadership affect investor confidence in market oversight.
